import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(req,pol,expected):
    r0=copy.deepcopy(req); p0=copy.deepcopy(pol)
    got=evaluate(req,pol)
    assert got==expected,(req,got,expected)
    assert req==r0 and pol==p0, 'inputs mutated'
    assert list(got)==['ok','value','reason']

p={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'op'}},'retry_limit':2}
check({'from':'a','to':'b'},p,{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})
check({'from':'x','to':'y'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'})
check({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'bad','attempts':99},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})
for a in (0,1): check({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':a},p,{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})
for a in (-1,2,True,False,1.0,'1',None): check({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':a},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})
reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))
assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in reqs]
print('all checks passed:',len(reqs)+11)
